change.before: daily recognition pushed a fixed 0.30 drawing threshold to the detector while speech used settings.speakThreshold (default 0.70); boxes between 0.30 and 0.70 were drawn but never announced
change.after: daily recognition pushes settings.speakThreshold as the detector threshold, so every drawn box is an announced box; developer diagnostics keep the independent drawing slider (default 0.30)
change.platforms: shared Dart: iOS daily recognition changes the same way and should be offered upstream
change.notCalibrated: 0.70 remains the legacy default documented in announcer.dart; it is not a calibrated per-class threshold

newTests: ios_demo_test: daily recognition draws only boxes it will announce (records setThreshold; fails with 0.30 when the old behaviour is restored)
ios_demo_test: developer diagnostics keep an independent drawing threshold

deviceCheck.observedTradeoff: a clearly visible pedestrian was not boxed at 0.70 (recall limit of the model, not addressed by thresholds)
